description: phpMyAdmin, pgAdmin, pgweb, Kafka UI, Mongo Express, and Attu now hide their management tool containers and add a "Manage" link back onto the resource(s) they manage, matching the pattern already used by Redis. Qdrant, RabbitMQ, the Durable Task Scheduler emulator, and Cosmos DB's built-in dashboard links are also renamed to "Manage" for consistency, and "Manage" links now sort above a resource's other URLs.
name: "Manage" link pattern extended to remaining management UI integrations
